# USA.gov
> Official U.S. government portal for finding federal benefits, services, agencies, and public information.

USA.gov helps people access government programs, contact agencies and elected officials, and find authoritative guidance on benefits, taxes, passports, housing, health, jobs, immigration, and other public services.

## Core Topics
- [All topics and services](https://www.usa.gov/#all-topics-header): Browse the full directory of USA.gov topic areas and service categories.
- [Government benefits](https://www.usa.gov/benefits): Find federal and state benefit programs, eligibility information, and application guidance.
- [The U.S. and its government](https://www.usa.gov/about-the-us): Learn about government structure, elections, agencies, and elected officials.
- [Complaints](https://www.usa.gov/complaints): Report consumer, product, financial, and service-related complaints to the right agency.
- [Disability services](https://www.usa.gov/disability-services): Access disability benefits, rights information, and support services.
- [Disasters and emergencies](https://www.usa.gov/disasters-and-emergencies): Find emergency preparedness, disaster recovery, and crisis assistance resources.
- [Education](https://www.usa.gov/education): Get information on student aid, loans, schools, and education programs.
- [Health](https://www.usa.gov/health): Explore health insurance, medical assistance, mental health, and public health resources.

## Benefits and Assistance
- [Government benefits](https://www.usa.gov/benefits): Central hub for food, healthcare, cash, and family assistance programs.
- [Housing help](https://www.usa.gov/housing-help): Find rental assistance, public housing, home repair, and homelessness resources.
- [Disability services](https://www.usa.gov/disability-services): Learn about disability income, accessibility rights, and support programs.
- [Health](https://www.usa.gov/health): Access Medicare, Medicaid, ACA coverage, and other health-related assistance.
- [Education](https://www.usa.gov/education): Find grants, loans, and federal education support for students and families.
- [Military and veterans](https://www.usa.gov/military-and-veterans): Locate military service information and veterans benefits resources.
- [Jobs, labor laws and unemployment](https://www.usa.gov/jobs-labor-laws-unemployment): Find unemployment benefits, job training, and worker protections.

## Money, Taxes, and Consumer Issues
- [Taxes](https://www.usa.gov/taxes): Get federal tax filing, refund, payment, and IRS help information.
- [Money and credit](https://www.usa.gov/money): Find unclaimed money, credit resources, savings bonds, and financial tools.
- [Scams and fraud](https://www.usa.gov/scams-and-fraud): Report scams, identity theft, and fraud to the proper authorities.
- [Complaints](https://www.usa.gov/complaints): File complaints about products, services, travel, banking, and more.
- [Small business](https://www.usa.gov/small-business): Access federal resources for starting, funding, and managing a business.
- [Laws and legal issues](https://www.usa.gov/laws-and-legal-issues): Find legal help, records, and rights information for common issues.

## Citizenship, Travel, and Identity
- [Immigration and U.S. citizenship](https://www.usa.gov/immigration-and-citizenship): Find visas, green cards, naturalization, and citizenship information.
- [The U.S. and its government](https://www.usa.gov/about-the-us): Learn how elections, voting, and public offices work in the United States.
- [Laws and legal issues](https://www.usa.gov/laws-and-legal-issues): Get help with vital records, identity documents, and legal processes.
- [1-844-USAGOV1](https://www.usa.gov/phone): Contact USA.gov for help finding government information and services.
- [Directory of U.S. government agencies and departments](https://www.usa.gov/agency-index): Look up federal agencies and departments by name.

## Government Structure and Agencies
- [The U.S. and its government](https://www.usa.gov/about-the-us): Overview of federal government institutions, elections, and civic processes.
- [Branches of government](https://www.usa.gov/branches-of-government): Learn about the executive, legislative, and judicial branches.
- [Directory of U.S. government agencies and departments](https://www.usa.gov/agency-index): Find official agency contact information and websites.
- [About USAGov](https://www.usa.gov/about): Learn about USA.gov and its role as a federal information portal.
- [Partner with us](https://www.usa.gov/partner-with-usagov): Information for organizations collaborating with USA.gov outreach efforts.
- [USAGov Outreach](https://www.usa.gov/outreach): Access outreach materials and public engagement resources.

## Public Safety and Emergency Help
- [Disasters and emergencies](https://www.usa.gov/disasters-and-emergencies): Find disaster assistance, emergency alerts, and preparedness guidance.
- [Scams and fraud](https://www.usa.gov/scams-and-fraud): Learn how to avoid, report, and recover from scams and fraud.
- [Complaints](https://www.usa.gov/complaints): Report unsafe products, services, and consumer problems.
- [Health](https://www.usa.gov/health): Find public health and emergency health information from government sources.
- [Laws and legal issues](https://www.usa.gov/laws-and-legal-issues): Access legal rights and protections related to safety and emergencies.

## Work, Business, and Economic Life
- [Jobs, labor laws and unemployment](https://www.usa.gov/jobs-labor-laws-unemployment): Search employment resources, labor rules, and unemployment assistance.
- [Small business](https://www.usa.gov/small-business): Find permits, loans, taxes, and federal business support resources.
- [Money and credit](https://www.usa.gov/money): Learn about personal finance, debt, credit, and government-held funds.
- [Taxes](https://www.usa.gov/taxes): Access tax obligations and filing information for individuals and businesses.
- [Innovation](https://www.usa.gov/innovation): Explore government innovation initiatives and modernization-related information.

## Help, Contact, and Site Resources
- [1-844-USAGOV1](https://www.usa.gov/phone): Phone support for finding government programs, agencies, and services.
- [Report a website issue](https://www.usa.gov/site-issue-report-form): Submit technical problems or errors found on the USA.gov website.
- [Website usage data](https://www.usa.gov/website-analytics/): View analytics and usage information for USA.gov properties.
- [Accessibility policy](https://www.usa.gov/accessibility-policy): Read USA.gov accessibility commitments and accommodation information.
- [Privacy and security policies](https://www.usa.gov/privacy-security): Review privacy, security, and website policy details.
- [FOIA requests](https://www.gsa.gov/reference/freedom-of-information-act-foia): Submit or learn about Freedom of Information Act requests through GSA.

## News and Editorial Content
- [USAGov blog](https://www.usa.gov/blog): Read updates, explainers, and timely articles about government services.
- [Feature articles](https://www.usa.gov/features): Browse featured stories and seasonal guidance on public services.
- [About USAGov](https://www.usa.gov/about): Background on the site, mission, and managing organization.
- [U.S. General Services Administration](https://www.gsa.gov/): Parent agency responsible for managing USA.gov.
